caption: The drawing depicts a wooden settee with three cushions and an ornate backrest profile featuring three curves, the center one being the highest. The upholstery appears in dark brown or black color, covering the seat and backrest, as well as the scrolled arms on both sides. The wood frame below the seat and the legs, illustrated in a medium brown tone, show detailed carving especially visible on the front legs, which curve outward at the bottom. The settee is centered within a rectangular border drawn in a thin line, and the background is plain, off-white paper. There is a small, dark signature or symbol located near the bottom right leg of the settee within the border.
title: Sofa
